quizName:
Hardest Questions in Maryland
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after you stop.
All cars must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When driving, you should wear a seat belt:
questions.explanation: You must always wear a seat belt when driving or sitting in the front seat. Anyone under 16 must wear a seat belt or use a child safety seat, no matter where they sit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot make a U-turn. It is a traffic rule that must be followed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that construction work is coming up. Pay attention to temporary traffic signs and slow down in work zones.

questions.question: Like alcohol and drugs, being very tired can:
questions.explanation: Not sleeping enough causes bad driving. Tiredness slows your reaction time, reduces your awareness, and harms your judgment, just like drugs and alcohol.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right on a red light if you are careful.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite way at this location.

questions.question: If you need to stop suddenly while driving on a highway, you should:

options.text: Honk your horn at other cars to get their attention.
Get out and signal the first car that passes.
Move to the shoulder, turn on your flashers, and stay in your car if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the shoulder, turn on your flashers, and stay in your car if possible.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on the side of a highway, turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers. Stay inside your car if you can. Standing on a highway is very dangerous because of fast traffic.

questions.question: If you are angry after an argument, you should:

options.text: Play loud music while driving so you forget about it.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Drive on the highway to feel better.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect how well you drive. If you are very angry, excited, scared, worried, or sad, take time to calm down before driving. You need to focus on driving without thinking about what upset you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead will change direction.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means you must stop.

questions.question: Where should children age 12 and under sit in a vehicle with airbags?

options.text: The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can hurt children. All children age 12 and under must sit in the back seat.

questions.question: What should you do if you become tired while driving?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: Stop and rest or let someone else drive. Tiredness slows your thinking and reactions, which makes driving unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. You must not make a right turn at this location.

questions.question: What should you do before you start driving?

options.text: Adjust the seat to a reclining position.
Properly adjust your seat and mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Properly adjust your seat and mirrors.
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat and mirrors for a good view. Make sure all passengers wear seat belts. Have your license and registration with you.

questions.question: What should you do if you encounter an aggressive driver?
questions.explanation: Let them pass and stay safe. Do not try to race or compete with other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to watch for bicycles and other road users in the area.

questions.question: What should you do if you become drowsy while driving?
questions.explanation: Stop at a rest area to nap, stretch, or switch drivers. Caffeine pills are not a safe substitute for rest.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming steep hill. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: You see lowered gates and flashing lights at a railroad crossing. What should you do?

options.text: Drive around the crossing gates if you don't see a train.
Stop well behind the gates. Wait for the tracks to clear and the gates to lift before you go.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop well behind the gates. Wait for the tracks to clear and the gates to lift before you go.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when signs, flashing lights, or flaggers warn you of a train. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, Disabled Veteran plates, or disabled parking placards.
